scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:debug: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev:debug" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:prod: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev:prod" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.start: cd backend && NODE_ENV=production npm run start
scripts.start:prod: npm run build:all && npm run start
